summary: InspireMD filed an 8-K disclosing warrant amendments with certain existing holders, including board members. Series J warrants (up to 9,543,952 shares) and Series K warrants (up to 9,543,947 shares) were amended. For amending holders, 50% of Series J shares and all Series K shares had exercise price modified to $0.7674 and termination accelerated to the earlier of May 15, 2028 or 20 trading days after FDA approval of CGuard Prime 80 cm; remaining Series J terms unchanged. The event is a repricing/acceleration of existing warrants rather than a new special situation.
